name: get_rankings
description: Get the App Store top free chart for a country, in chart order with #1 first: the overall chart by default, or one category via category_id (see get_categories). name: add_to_watchlist
description: Add an app to your watchlist, and with a keyword_id also track that keyword for the app. A keyword is tracked only for an app on your watchlist. Needs an API key bound to an account.

name: get_similar_apps
description: Find apps similar in meaning to one app, using embedding similarity over their listings (limited to the given storefront). Each result has rating, rating count, revenue and downloads estimates and a distance (lower means closer). Results are sorted by downloads estimate, biggest first, not by distan

name: get_reviews
description: Get the most recent user reviews we have stored for one iOS app, newest first: title, text, star rating (rating), author, app version reviewed and date. Takes no country argument. Use it to read what users say; use get_app_details for the overall rating and rating count. Returns an empty list when w

name: get_timeline
description: Get every recorded change to one iOS app listing: version, name, subtitle, price, screenshots and description, newest first, with the day each change was first seen.

name: get_categories
description: List every App Store category as a category_id and category_name pair (a fixed list, no arguments, no network call). Use it to find the category_id to pass to get_rankings; the overall chart is category_id 36.

name: get_ranking_history
description: Get one app's top-free chart position per day in one storefront, as ranking_position and created_at points. The chart is the overall chart when the app has ever ranked there, otherwise the app's own category chart. Look back 1 to 3650 days (default 30). Use it for trends and for explaining a move; u

name: get_revenue_history
description: Get the worldwide monthly downloads and revenue estimates for one iOS app, one point per data month (dated its first day). Values are Sensor Tower buckets; downloadsFloor/revenueFloor mark the stored 1,000, which means "< 5K", not an exact figure.

name: get_keywords
description: Get the App Store search terms one iOS app is collected as ranking for, with its position and the day that position was observed.

name: get_ads
description: Get the ad creatives one iOS app is running, with the ad library each came from and how many that library holds for the app.

name: get_tracked_apps
description: Get the apps this API key's own account is monitoring, newest first. Scoped to the caller: a key bound to another account sees a different set, and a key bound to no account is refused.

name: get_keyword_watchlist
description: Get the keywords this API key's own account has asked us to track, with each keyword's next scheduled SERP sweep. Scoped to the caller, same as get_tracked_apps.

name: search_designs
description: Search real iPhone app screens that App Store Tracker captured itself (the library at /designs) by describing what you want to see, e.g. "paywall with a free trial toggle and the yearly plan preselected", "onboarding that asks for the user's goals", "notification permission pre-prompt".
